blurb: Dr. John B. Scannella, Curator of the Museum of the Rockies, comes to Choteau to speak at the Roxy Theatre on Tuesday June 9th at 6 PM. Scannella’s lecture “Climbing Egg Mountain” will venture through a wide range of local paleontological topics, including Egg Mountain, Maiasaura, the Two Medicine Formation and more!.
